messages:
Maya Patel: thinking out loud — prototype for a rollout cost estimator in the Console. small panel that shows expected delta in tokens, cache savings, and $$ impact per 1k requests for a canary. toggle between raw and amortized views. thoughts?
Cheng Wu: love the idea. main gotcha is sampling bias when we surface per-route cache savings — prefetches + sticky routing skew estimates.
Sam Rodriguez: +1. also need model-level granularity. a route can hit multiple model SKUs depending on fallbacks. estimator should accept a fallback mix.
Lin Park: sticky routing makes cache savings look bigger for canaries if route pins to warm hosts. we should expose both "with sticky" and "without sticky" numbers.
Maya Patel: good point. UI could show two columns: observed (what actually happened) vs normalized (no-stickiness, normalized session mix).
Cheng Wu: for telemetry, we can add a short SQL snippet to compute normalized token delta. sample:```sql
SELECT model_sku, avg(tokens) as mean_tokens, sum(is_cache_hit) as cache_hits
FROM request_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY model_sku;
```This needs sample-weighting by session_id to avoid request storms biasing short sessions.
Sam Rodriguez: also include KV cache lineage tag so we can attribute cache hits to prefetched prefixes vs real reuse. add `cache_origin=prefix_prefetch|kv_reuse` tag.
Priya Shah: from finance: please add projected USD impact and an option to apply a margin of error (e.g., 10%) so sales can preview billing effects. also need currency conversion for EU customers.
Maya Patel: noted. UI idea: slider for confidence margin and a checkbox "include amortized infra" which spreads reserved GPU cost across requests.
Lin Park: infra amortization is tricky — better to show reserved vs burst costs separately. reserved cost / active_seconds gives per-second baseline, then convert to per-token with mean throughput.
Cheng Wu: agree. will prototype a query that outputs: tokens_per_second, avg_latency, reserve_utilization_percent, and cache_hit_rate. then estimator combines formulas.
Maya Patel: can someone mock a tiny backend response shape? just a flat JSON the Console can consume. e.g. `{"scenario":"canary","delta_tokens":1234,"delta_usd":1.23,"notes":"normalised"}`
Sam Rodriguez: I'll sketch the shape and the UI rows: baseline, observed_canary, normalized_canary, delta_abs, delta_pct, monthlyized_projection.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: feature/rollout-cost-estimator -> staging (CI 4738) by @sam. ETA 3m.
ops-bot: FYI sampling job for telemetry (job id 998) completed 6m ago. sample rate 1%.
